items.description: Kitchen leak detection and moisture measurement
items.rationale: Sections 2.4.2 and 7.1.7(e)–(g) cover locating the supply leak, measuring the affected floor and wall base, and one call-out. Using Case 21, allow 14 technician-hours at about €46 gross plus €230 for attendance, €450 for acoustic pinpointing and €165 for moisture measurement.

items.description: Access, repair and re-insulation of copper supply pipe
items.rationale: Sections 2.4.3(a) and 7.1.7 cover necessary access and like-for-like repair of the failed indoor pipe. Allow about €140 to expose the run, €200 to replace just over 1.5 m of copper with matching fittings, and €60 to remove and replace the soaked foam lagging.
Section 7.1.7(f) allows the plumber's first travel charge on this invoice, independently of the leak detection firm's call-out. Allow €76 gross, consistent with Case 21.

items.description: Drying of kitchen floor and wall base
items.rationale: Sections 7.1.5 and 7.1.7(b), (e) cover drying the documented wet areas and hiring the dryer. Allow about €50 for one condensation dryer for roughly seven days and €130 for setup, collection and completion readings, with no separate electricity allowance under 7.1.8(d).
